Class Permissions

java.lang.Object
com.happyuky7.openvoxelmoding.server.permissions.Permissions
public final class Permissions extends Object
Permission API for OpenVoxel servers (the game has none). Plugins call has(Player, String); a provider answers. The built-in provider uses operators (plugins/ModLoader/ops.yml) and the default nodes from plugins/ModLoader/permissions.yml; a permission plugin such as LuckPerms replaces it with setProvider(Provider).

Commands are protected automatically: running /name needs the node mapped to it with registerCommand(String, String) or in permissions.yml, else openvoxel.command.<name>.
